title: Extensibility: a check as a catalogue entry, an eval as a folder

cards.title: Add without changing what is there
cards.text: A plug-in point names what joins it; a new check, eval, pack, theme or site plugs in by its owner's list.

cards.title: Checks and evals as content
cards.text: A check a catalogue entry, an eval a folder of files, a domain ships readers.

cards.title: Packs and identities
cards.text: A pack ships its checks; core ships no agent; a second identity joins one catalogue.

cards.title: The framework's web
cards.text: Described screens, the admin's and the chat's frames, a site that names its areas.

cards.title: Themes on a contract
cards.text: A theme is values for every name the framework lists, light and dark.

cards.title: The framework's pages
cards.text: A package any site turns on, and one door with four ways to ask.
